learning_outcomes.text: Use graphic representation techniques, both by traditional methods of metric geometry and descriptive geometry and by computer-aided design applications, in three-dimensional engineering design.

Recognize and understand graphic representation techniques, both by traditional methods of metric geometry and descriptive geometry and by computer-aided design applications, that are applied in three-dimensional engineering design.
Ability to manage NTIC-based environments and their emerging technologies.
Project in the field of industrial technical engineering.
Develop projects in the field of industrial technical engineering.
Adapt the organization of content and the use of language, verbal and non-verbal, to argue in various situations or before diverse audiences.
Develop measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert reports, studies, reports, task plans and other works typical of the field of technical engineering.
Recognize and understand the legislation necessary for the exercise of the industrial technical engineer profession.
Show the advantages and opportunities of different solutions to the same problem in a critical and constructive way.
Correctly use, when pertinent, specifications, regulations, and mandatory standards.
Apply the appropriate legislation to the exercise of the industrial technical engineer profession.
Recognize and understand the graphic representation techniques applied in engineering.
Use graphic representation techniques in three-dimensional engineering design.

syllabus_topics: SISTEMA DE REPRESENTACIÓN DE PLANOS ACOTADOS.
Introduction to the System of Representation of Referenced Planes. Fundamentals. Point notation. Positions.
Representation of the line. Representation of the plane. Intersections between planes. Intersection between line and plane
Parallelism. Perpendicularity and distances. Abatements. Projections of curves. Roofs. Topographic applications.
Fundamentals of the axonometric system. Reduction factors. Scales. Types of perspectives and characteristics.
BLOQUE IV. DISEÑO ASISTIDO POR ORDENADOR.
teaching_methods: Problem-solving/exercise resolution in the ordinary classroom
assessment_rules: The final grade is composed of written or practical assignments (6%), other forms of evaluation (6%), case studies / applied activities (13%), mixed tests (70%), and continuous evaluation (5%). The mixed tests include two exams, accounting for 20% and 50% respectively. No minimum marks or resit arrangements are specified.
